name: Paralympics

flag.description: A white field with three crescent-shaped swooshes, red, blue and green, curving around a central point.
flag.symbolism: The three agitos (Latin for 'I move') stand for movement and the spirit of Paralympic athletes; red, blue and green are the colours most widely found in national flags.

hook: The Paralympic flag has three swooshes, red, blue and green, swirling round an empty centre; the Olympic flag has five interlocking rings.
trivia: The first Paralympic logo, made for the 1988 Seoul Games, used five Korean-style teardrop shapes arranged like the Olympic rings.
The three-agitos design was introduced in 2004 and refreshed in 2019 with brighter colours matching the Olympic rings.
